title: Surgical Strike
youtubeTitle: Subspace Lattice Academy Ep.2 — Surgical Strike (7-Ply Mission)
description: Mission 1 walkthrough: refuse the hang, then convert a Beam file into Surgical Strike. From the Fleet Academy advanced manual.

scenes.headline: Surgical Strike
scenes.subhead: A seven-ply highlight reel: grow the net, refuse the hang, end the game.
scenes.voiceover: Episode two: Surgical Strike. A short, fixed highlight reel — not a full match. Watch how fast a Hub hunt ends when a mistake is punished.
Starting position. White already holds the Initiative Relay Escort forward. Black’s Hub sits on a file White’s Beam can eventually claim — if the net opens and the Hub stays safe.
Ply one. White pushes the relay Escort. Deepening the foothold grows midboard coverage so later Beam fire has somewhere to live.
Ply two. Black does not yet contest the Beam’s file — a quiet side step while White telegraphs net-building on the left.
Ply three. White slides an Escort beside the Beam’s file — extending the blue glow toward Black’s Hub without sitting on the lane and blocking the shot.

scenes.prompt: Black just stepped next to White’s Hub. What does the three-question scan say?
scenes.voiceover: Ply four. Black reaches for a classic beginner trap: step next to White’s Hub. Pause and predict — if White stares at the Beam shot and ignores this, Black takes Surgical Strike next.
scenes.revealVoiceover: Ply five. White refuses the hang. The prepared Beam shot can wait one ply — Hub safety always comes first. Capture the threat.

scenes.voiceover: Ply six. Black’s trap failed. Tempo lost — and Black’s Hub is still sitting on White’s Beam file.
Ply seven. Net open, Hub safe, enemy Hub on the Beam’s file. White converts preparation into Surgical Strike — the usual way fleet games end when the plan works.

scenes.headline: Lesson: Hub safety outranks the shot
scenes.voiceover: Core lesson: Hub safety outranks material and net-building. Next: a chess-length battle — openings, trade fights, and a walk-in finish.
